prompt: Compose a COMPLETE original 30-second instrumental micro-score for a short product promotional video. Exactly one short cue, not a full-length song. Sound: tactile acoustic minimalism; interlocking wooden percussion and witty plucked melody. Instruments: woodblocks, pizzicato strings, marimba, brushed snare. Tempo 120 BPM, 4/4. Main hook: a rising fourth with a syncopated answer. [00:00] Immediate confident musical hook and beat within the first half-second, no intro or fade-in. [00:02] Establish a catchy clear groove with space for visual edits. [00:16] One crisp stop-and-restart or timbral switch, then a slightly fuller reprise. [00:26] A concise resolving fill. [00:29] A decisive final musical button for a logo reveal. [00:30] End completely after the brief natural decay. Total duration 30 seconds. Maintain the hook throughout, usable from any downbeat. Punchy but not harsh, audible melody and rhythm on phone speakers, controlled sub-bass, no long riser, no slow build or repeated sections. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: A lighthearted and playful orchestral piece with a bouncy rhythm, featuring pizzicato strings, woodwinds, and a walking bassline. It evokes a whimsical and cheerful atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首轻松活泼的管弦乐曲，节奏欢快，以拨弦乐器、木管乐器和行进贝斯线为特色。营造出异想天开、欢快的氛围。
